overall_notes: This paper focuses on evaluating efficiency robustness of VLMs through adversarial attacks, primarily measuring computational metrics like I-length, I-latency, and I-energy. While it evaluates NLG outputs (image captions), the main focus is on efficiency rather than NLG quality. The paper includes BLEU and text feature dissimilarity as secondary metrics to show the attacks also slightly degrade caption quality.
